partnership_angle: Referral partner AND sandbox tester — the strongest dual-fit candidate found. As a tech-forward boutique (CTO co-founder with CS background, in-house pen testing) already embedded in Drata, Vanta, AND Secureframe ecosystems, they clearly embrace automation rather than fear it, making them ideal validators of an AWS-native scanning tool. Their entire funnel is first-time SOC 2 startups (1-100 employees, cloud-hosted), which maps exactly to LoxeAI's ICP, and their fast/affordable positioning means a pre-audit readiness scan that shortens engagements complements their business model instead of cannibalizing it. Patrick Sesi (CTO) is the published entry point for partnerships.
pitch_note: Reach out to Patrick Sesi: 'You built Zero Day around getting cloud startups through their first SOC 2 fast — LoxeAI is an AWS-native readiness scanner built for exactly those clients. Would you run a scan against a sandbox AWS account (or your own environment) and tear it apart? If it holds up to your standards, your pre-audit pipeline gets a tool you can hand to prospects — run this scan first, it gets you ~80% ready before fieldwork — which makes your 4-6 week turnarounds even faster and your Drata/Vanta-side clients cleaner on day one.' The ask is a 20-minute call plus one sandbox scan; validation converts them into a referral channel for every not-yet-ready startup that calls them too early.
